title: sambucus mexicana var. bipinnata
intro: Sambucus mexicana var. bipinnata, commonly known as Mexican elderberry, is a plant species in the Adoxaceae family, native to Mexico and parts of Central America. The health benefits of Mexican elderberry include its antiviral and anti-inflammatory properties, which have been traditionally used to treat various health issues such as fever, colds, and respiratory infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to act as an antioxidant, antimicrobial, and antihistamine, making it useful for soothing allergies, reducing inflammation, and supporting immune function. The bioactive constituents of Mexican elderberry include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
